purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 806 Sha Tin (city code 11590); city-local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
registryBasis: Hong Kong Lands Department and Land Registry provide local land/cadastral services; the Lands Department has a Sha Tin District Lands Office. The CSDI Lands Department Lot dataset is an official public Polygon Feature Layer (EPSG:2326) with safe identifiers OBJECTID, LotID, LotCSUID. A restricted exact-point query found no intersecting lot; a 200 m envelope returned one complete nearby polygon 52.02 m from the WUP point.

officialSources.observation: Official Lands Department contact page lists the Sha Tin District Lands Office.
Official Land Registry explains its public IRIS land-record ordering and map-based lot/PRN lookup; this is a records service rather than the polygon source.
Official CSDI dataset “Lot,” provided by Lands Department and categorized as Land Parcel Framework spatial data.

Anonymous service/layer metadata GET returned HTTP 200. Polygon layer in EPSG:2326; fields: OBJECTID (OID), Shape__Length/Area, LotID (integer), LotCSUID (string). Query return fields were restricted to OBJECTID,LotID,LotCSUID.

Official LandsD map-service notice describes displayed parcel polygons as approximate-location aids, not legal boundary indications; this is an accuracy caveat, not a blocker to recording sample geometry.

searchQueries.query: Sha Tin Hong Kong official Lands Department land registry cadastral lot map API polygon data
searchQueries.result: LandsD lists Sha Tin District Lands Office and its open CSDI Lot dataset. Public layer metadata confirms a Polygon Feature Layer in EPSG:2326 with fields OBJECTID, LotID and LotCSUID as safe identifiers plus only geometry length/area. A WUP-point intersection request returned zero features; a bounded 200 m envelope returned one full nearby polygon after allowlisting only the three identifiers.

searchQueries.query: 香港 沙田 地政處 土地註冊 地段地籍圖 LandsD Lot API 官方
searchQueries.result: 地政總署列有沙田地政處；CSDI 官方「地段」資料集由地政總署提供。圖層結構只有安全地段識別碼與幾何量測欄位；以排除其他欄位的方式查詢，WUP 點位未命中，200 米範圍內返回一個完整相鄰地段多邊形。

accessReview.reason: One complete public polygon and safe identifiers were verified, but the WUP point itself did not intersect a lot in the point query. This is a nearby sample rather than evidence that the weighted centroid lies on a parcel. Runtime integration and citywide completeness are not assessed.

requestEvidence.observation: Official anonymous ArcGIS service metadata; no parcel feature data read. Located Polygon layer 0 in EPSG:2326.
Layer schema: OBJECTID, Shape__Length, Shape__Area, LotID, LotCSUID; only OBJECTID/LotID/LotCSUID allowlisted for feature requests.

requestEvidence.request: Point intersection at queued WUP point transformed to EPSG:2326; outFields=OBJECTID,LotID,LotCSUID; outSR=4326; returnGeometry=true.
200 m by 200 m envelope centered at queued WUP point in EPSG:2326; outFields=OBJECTID,LotID,LotCSUID; outSR=4326; returnGeometry=true; resultRecordCount=3.
requestEvidence.result: One Polygon returned, OBJECTID=367394, LotID=1910159279, LotCSUID preserved; 127 vertices, closed ring, distance 52.02 m from WUP point; full geometry retained in repo sample.

technicalBlocker: One complete public polygon and safe identifiers were verified, but the WUP point itself did not intersect a lot in the point query. This is a nearby sample rather than evidence that the weighted centroid lies on a parcel. Runtime integration and citywide completeness are not assessed.
remainingUncertainty: One nearby polygon was retained; no parcel was returned at the exact point. LandsD map products carry an approximate-location disclaimer, and the sample does not establish legal boundary accuracy or territory-wide completeness.
